app.name: AeroFTP
app.one_liner: A cross-platform desktop file client supporting FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, S3, GitHub, and cloud providers like MEGA and Filen, with AI-powered tools, AES-256 encryption, and a 15-source profile bridge.

screens.name: Application Settings
screens.purpose: Manages global preferences including theme selection, language, encryption settings, and AI provider configuration.

screens.name: Main File Manager
screens.purpose: Provides dual-panel file browsing with endpoint-aware unification across local, remote, and encrypted storage sources.
primary_actions: Toggle between unified and split view

screens.name: Profile Bridge Dialog
screens.purpose: Enables import/export of connection profiles from 15+ external tools including rclone, AWS CLI, Cyberduck, and restic.

rust_commands.name: execute_cli_ls_command
rust_commands.purpose: Lists directory contents via CLI interface using native protocol handlers.

rust_commands.name: import_profile_from_external_tool
rust_commands.purpose: Imports connection profiles from external CLI/GUI tools by auto-detecting config paths and securely migrating credentials into AeroVault.

rust_commands.name: switch_protocol_for_profile
rust_commands.purpose: Changes the protocol type (e.g., FTP to SFTP) for an existing connection profile while preserving compatible settings.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add AeroVault stub for credential storage
week 1: Implement core dual-panel file browser with local/remote toggle
week 1: Integrate basic FTP/SFTP connection handling
week 2: Add CLI `ls` command with error reporting
week 2: Build profile import logic for rclone and WinSCP
week 2: Implement protocol switching for editable profiles
acceptance_tests: CLI `ls` command successfully lists contents of a connected S3 bucket.
Installer does not interfere with other CLI applications on system PATH.
Koofr API connections succeed without returning 404 errors.
User can switch protocol type when editing a Filen profile without error.
